name: God Calling People
overview: God initiates a personal call to individuals, as seen in Proverbs 1:24 where He extends His hand even when it is refused, and in Jeremiah 1:5 where He ordains His servants before their birth. This divine calling invites believers to prioritize seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above all else (Matthew 6:33). While many are called to respond, only a few are chosen, highlighting the seriousness of responding to God's invitation (Matthew 22:14). The call includes a commission to proclaim the gospel to all nations, empowered by the Lord's presence and confirmation through signs (Mark 16:15, 20).
